job.text: Show a new manager how each region's donations compare with its target

insight.important: Central and North fell short of their targets; the other regions beat theirs

title.text: Central and North Missed Their Donation Targets

source.shows: comparison values: each region's target as a short dark mark across its bar, named once beside the first bar with thin leaders, no legend (R15-7, G8.13, G5.5)

insight.important: South and Central brought in the most

title.text: South and Central Brought in the Most Donations

source.shows: the book's version without comparison values: nothing tells the reader how to feel about the numbers; the report asks for a target (R15-7, G8.12)
each bar coloured by its own target, good or bad, in red and green (G4.16, D-18)
